content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Tezpur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tezpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor and Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Tezpur University is recruiting for a total of 2 posts, with one vacancy for Assistant Professor (on contractual basis) and one for Guest Faculty.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. degree in Design or related fields. Alternatively, a Bachelor's Degree or a 4-year Diploma in Design, Fine Arts, Architecture, or Engineering with a Master's degree in a relevant discipline is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Assistant Professor (contractual) position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor (contractual) will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 80,000/- per month. No other allowances will be admissible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty will be paid Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly salary capped at Rs. 50,000/-. No additional allowances are provided.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for Tezpur University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply through email. The application form and necessary documents should be sent to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing candidates based on their academic scores as per UGC Regulations, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Tezpur University?
faq.answer: The official website of Tezpur University is www.tezu.ernet.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their applications?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for Assistant Professor (Contractual) against Advt. No. 27/2026".
